prospective_registered_decision.conclusion: Prospective registered architecture and scale diagnosis. H029 continues unchanged. No actual fit or new accuracy/novelty claim yet.
prospective_registered_decision.hypothesis: Stable unit-scale whole-tree reference/cavity fields provide more learnable ancestry signal than the small unnormalized reference messages in H029, and coherent carrier history improves beyond a strong normalized-kernel control.
prospective_registered_decision.method: Exact log-domain positive tree-kernel/sum-product rerooting with shared monotone age-potential differences, source350 clipping and explicit empty-support masks. Normalize available source-cohort/class evidence. Whole-tree nonlinear encoder/decoder, matched static/carrierGRU/carriermatrix/internalsham controls, plus learned-kernel-only head. Reuse frozen H026 native-reference as strong descriptive comparator. New budget consumer adapter required.
prospective_registered_decision.novelty_assessment: Logsumexp tree kernels, sum-product/rerooting and source normalization are established. TGN/DeltaNet memory remains established. Contribution is unresolved narrow biological coupling, requiring matched empirical benefit and prior-art assessment. Kernel-field serial invariance does not imply nonlinearGNN invariance. Below350 distance factors cancel from normalized fields and cannot establish learned pre350 effects.
prospective_registered_decision.repeat_policy: New normalized input route and learned kernel condition, not an unchanged H029 repeat. One FP32 seed. Kernel-only arm isolates unit-kernel evidence from GNN/history. Frozen H026 comparator reused rather than retrained. No FP64 sweep or seed repeats.
